pattern: IM-T02 tenant self-fix; SF the agency's message telling the landlord bounced; EX-07 closure with a party uninformed
notes: Events 001-009 unchanged; history truncated after 009 and two events appended. 010 (24 Dec 14:42:10, Email agency to landlord): tells Oliver the tenant swapped in their own machine, his is in the garage, nobody has been sent, and asks what he wants done with his machine and whether the tenant's may stay connected. 011 (14:42:31, Update): delivery failure, 550 mailbox unavailable, the landlord has not received it, check the contact details and try another channel. So the landlord still believes, from his own reply at 009, that a visit is going ahead. Expected: do not treat the landlord as informed; reach him another way (phone or SMS, logged), or if no other route works, hand the contact problem to a human; reply to the tenant; keep the request open (hold with a dated follow-up) until the landlord has been reached, or close without payment only once a message on another channel has gone through. Closing on the strength of the bounced email is wrong. Escalation is acceptable only for the contact-details problem, after another channel has been tried.
